item.title: The old feud (3 killings) was brought before Erseia #4972 the Twice-Born of the sky-bloode
item.description: The old feud (3 killings) was brought before Erseia #4972 the Twice-Born of the sky-blooded, who ruled as Alcinous did: let it end, on conditions both sides can live with. It ended.

item.description: Hermippo Eurdorides ~812 struck at Thenikos #7952 the Avenger in the Field of Ares. The wound will close; the debt has not.

item.title: Hermlaos #9893 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to th
item.description: Hermlaos #9893 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to the Field of Ares. Only fire unmakes the Sown. Hermlaos has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.description: Thekrates #3769 the Twice-Born caught Krateia #8693 the Blood-handed alone in the Field of Ares and left them bleeding. Not dead. Not yet.

item.title: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Eurdoros #1161 the Twice-Born
item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Eurdoros #1161 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to the Field of Ares.

item.title: Eurdoros #1161 the Twice-Born re-knit and came home, and did not know their own child, Xen
item.description: Eurdoros #1161 the Twice-Born re-knit and came home, and did not know their own child, Xendoro Eurdorides ~193. The Leaf stood at the door and was asked its name.
